en.prompt: Write three short speaker beats for a museum briefing as of 19 April 2021. Ingenuity flew autonomously at Wright Brothers Field on Mars to about 3 m, hovered for 30 seconds, and landed 39.1 seconds after takeoff. The flight proves powered, controlled flight on another planet. A proposed slide calls 3 m divided by the whole flight time 'the average climb speed.' Decide whether to use that metric. Give the audience a defensible proportion for time spent hovering and explain why the remaining time does or does not identify climb speed. Close with what the team could decide after reviewing flight data; do not assume a later test succeeded. Write the answer in English.
checks: Reports the first Mars flight as autonomous, powered and controlled, retains about 3 m and distinguishes 30 s of hover from 39.1 s total.
Derives roughly 77% hovering and identifies the remaining 9.1 s as non-hover time including ascent and descent; rejects using total time to infer climb speed.
Uses three short audience-facing beats and closes on reviewing the flight data to inform the next test, without claiming future success.
